scope: Static independent review; no execution of generated flash script and no mutation of reviewed sources
checked: Every readback filename is removed and absence checked before FPT dump.
Every success flag is removed and absence checked before gate execution.
FPT and gate exit status is checked immediately before any later command can overwrite lasterror.
Both successful gate exit and expected flag existence are required.
Candidate FPT write failure, dump failure, or POST failure go to rollback.
Abort before any write may reboot the unchanged firmware.
All flash and readback commands use start 0x01B16000 and size 0x13000.
if not equality, if not exist, goto labels, and exit /b syntax supported by UEFI shell.
Rollback first removes stale region-restored.bin, performs fresh dump, and runs Restoregate with exit0 plus fresh marker; when exact original is confirmed, it skips restore write.
If that initial check fails, rollback writes ORIGINAL and records any nonzero FPT status, then requires another freshly produced dump and exact Restoregate comparison.
No path reaches restored/reset after restore attempt without successful fresh dump plus successful Restoregate plus fresh RESTORED.flag.
Abort/reset remains reachable only before the first attempted flash.
A failed dump, undeletable stale readback/marker or failed Restoregate after restore attempt goes to fatal with no scripted reset.
integration_note: Build script reads TcssRegionGate.c and writes EFI beside itself; package generator reads EFI under firmware-candidate. Operator must stage/copy built outputs accordingly; no assumption that running build script locally would work.
limits: This review does not validate successful boot after patch.
A stop in fatal avoids a scripted reset, but cannot guarantee recovery after a later loss of power or manual reset.
Corrected native security gate is reviewed separately by storico_prove.

primary_sources.support: ProcessStatement handles not at397, exist at417, equality at556; TestOperation numeric equality at214.
MainCmdGoto prepends colon then searches matching label.
UEFI shell scripting and exit /b specification.
